programs.title: Stratton
programs.desc: (2017) Action thriller starring Dominic Cooper. A rogue Russian operative plots to unleash deadly biochemical weapons. Special Boat Service commando John Stratton is sent in to hunt him down.

programs.title: Panhandle
programs.desc: (1948) Western starring Rod Cameron. A former Texas marshal is determined to prove a powerful casino owner is behind his brother's murder.

programs.title: Redemption Day
programs.desc: (2021) Action thriller with Gary Dourdan, Serinda Swan and Andy Garcia. A war hero embarks on a daring rescue mission when his wife is kidnapped. As the clock counts down, can he get to her in time?

programs.title: The Air I Breathe
programs.desc: (2007) Crime drama with Brendan Fraser. Visions, threats, desperate measures, and high-stakes gambles intertwine in this white-knuckle thriller that never stops for breath.

programs.title: Lone Rider
programs.desc: (2008) Gutsy western starring Lou Diamond Phillips. A decorated soldier returning home after the American Civil War finds that an evil land owner has taken over the town.
